text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rudolf. You know, our uniform's
cute and
all...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But I get the feeling that a liiittle
tweaking would
make everyone feel
even more powerful!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Uniforms are not something that can be
changed
on a whim, but... Let's hear it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Far out! Lemme give you the skinny. ☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There's an item that, when put in
clothes, makes
you appear super
dignified and waaay cooler
instantly!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Shoulder pads... I believe I've heard of
them. The
fact that they can change
your silhouette so
drastically is indeed
interesting.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? Strong shoulders are the
sign of a
strong person. ☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Everyone will look super fresh with their
new,
bold shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Perhaps I will bring this up in the
next
student council meeting.
